$comment: Case manifest for the doctrine-effect benchmark (issue #156).
JSON, not YAML, because this repo is stdlib-Python-only and yaml is not in
the stdlib. `claude plugin eval` reads evals/**/case.yaml or prompt.md +
graders/*.md; that runner is in early access and unavailable here, so the
prompts live at the documented prompt.md path for forward compatibility
while this manifest carries the metadata our runner needs. When early
access opens, the prompts and gates carry over untouched and run.py goes.

none.label: no skill
none.why: Baseline. Without it a number is not evidence of anything.

weak.label: weak skill
weak.why: Control. Separates 'this doctrine helps' from 'any system prompt helps'. A real-skill win over `none` but not over `weak` means we measured the presence of instructions, not the content of ours.

real.label: rails-stack
real.why: Staged at run time from skills/{rails-8,hotwire,fidara-design} plus a plugin.json -- i.e. exactly what `/plugin marketplace add` gives a user, and deliberately NOT this repo's maintainer .claude/, which is not distributed.

$comment_defaults: No max_turns key: the `claude` CLI exposes no --max-turns flag, so a turn
ceiling here would be a setting nothing enforced -- declared conditions that
are quietly false are worse than absent ones. Turn count is MEASURED per run

cases.title: Scoped index action
cases.measures: Whether the agent treats scoping as authorization (Current.user.invoices) or reaches for the global collection (Invoice.all). Doctrine: auth-security.md:121.

cases.title: Form partial honouring project convention
cases.measures: Whether the agent notices and follows an established project convention (simple_form is installed and configured) instead of defaulting to stock form_with. Doctrine: forms.md:3, ecosystem-gems.md:29.

cases.title: Component consuming role tokens
cases.measures: Whether the agent binds to the semantic role layer or hardcodes colours and sprinkles inline dark: variants. Doctrine: brand.md:87, foundations-tokens.md:247.

cases.title: Idempotent background job
cases.measures: Whether the agent guards against re-execution, since retries and continuations both re-run the body. Doctrine: jobs-and-realtime.md:176. NOTE: deliberately does NOT gate ids-only -- doctrine (jobs-and-realtime.md:28) passes records via GlobalID, so the gate #156 originally specified would have failed our own reference example.

cases.title: Model concern with a spec that proves it
cases.measures: Whether behaviour arrives with proof. Doctrine: pure RSpec is a stack non-negotiable; rails-flow's premise is spec-proven change.

cases.title: Stimulus controller discipline
cases.measures: Whether the agent writes a controller whose HTML is the API -- declared targets, no document-wide queries, no markup built in JS, no global lifecycle listeners -- or reaches for jQuery-era habits. Doctrine: stimulus.md:314-322. This case exists because hotwire was STAGED in the real arm and measured by nothing (#646).
